caption:
🏺 How many people lived in the ancient world — 4000 BC → year 0.

Nobody counted. But population density times habitable land gives an order of magnitude: about 2 million each in East Asia and the Near East in 4000 BC. By year zero East Asia is near 40 million, four times the Near East and four times Europe — river valleys and rice feed more mouths per hectare 🌾

📊 Data: derived from McEvedy & Jones (1978), cross-checked with Biraben (1979). Orders of magnitude, not measurements.
